issues.message: The file uses Combat Extended classes outside the gated Combat Extended folder, so the game reports errors when Combat Extended is not active.

fix.summary: Move the file to Common/Compat/CombatExtended/Patches/CE_Patch.xml and gate that folder in LoadFolders.xml, or list Combat Extended as a required mod.
